## M3 Appointment Request
Input: context from M1. Builds reply + rows, upserts lead (dedup on lead_key), and when name+phone are present notifies staff (M8) and texts patient (M9, gated).
NEVER confirms a time — only 'request received'.
After import: point 'Upsert Lead' at M7, 'Notify Staff' at M8, 'Send Patient SMS' at M9.

parameters.jsCode: const c = { ...$('Build Reply + Rows').item.json }; delete c._apptRow; delete c._email; delete c._sms; delete c._ready; return { json: c };
